# Magnetic Common Design System tokens

This directory vendors the generated Magnetic theme CSS variables used by the
standalone installer. The installer remains framework-free and maps its local
component classes onto these design tokens.

- Source repository: `magnetic-common-design-system`
- Source revision: `800699bc1bb009aca4d41479ff4955c811982175`

- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.md`

`token-theme-variables.css` is copied without modification. Product styling
belongs in `installer/src/styles.css`.
